item.description: Cinco países de la Unión Europea acordaron avanzar en la creación de un centro de retorno de migrantes en Ruanda, que debería entrar en funcionamiento en 2027. La iniciativa busca trasladar a personas cuyas solicitudes de asilo fueron rechazadas y que no pueden volver a sus países de origen. item.title: How a toxin helps African lungfish survive on land
item.description: For centuries, scientists have been fascinated by critical steps in animal evolution, such as the advent of multicellularity or the ability to fly. One such evolutionary step many have heard about is vertebrate adaptation to land. Adventuring onto land is one of the best-known stories of vertebrate success, a strategy that drove their diversification. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Inside Nigeria's illegal gold mining industry

The vast majority of these resources are mined illegally, meaning billions of euros are not included in the national GDP. Two years ago, the Nigerian government launched a paramilitary force, The Mining Marshals, to fight this illegal activity. Our Nigerian team visited an informal mine and then accompanied a patrol of Mining Marshals, here is their Report. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Scientists in South Africa have named a new dinosaur whose young already weighed about 400 kg
item.description: A groundbreaking discovery in South Africa has unveiled a new dinosaur species named Nyana rooiwalensis. This juvenile, weighing approximately 400 kilograms at just three years old, shows signs of rapid growth through bone analysis. Nyana is categorized among sauropodomorphs, the ancestors of the gigantic dinosaurs we know today. This finding provides vital insights into the evolutionary journey and growth dynamics of early dinosaurs. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
